description: You are a data officer for the National Tuberculosis Programme of Sierra Leone. The quarterly cohort analysis report is due. Using DHIS2 at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district): (1) Navigate to the Tracker Capture or Capture module and find the TB programme. Search for all TB programme tracked entity instances (patients) enrolled in Western Area Urban district. Export the patient working list as a file to /home/ga/Downloads/. (2) Navigate to the analytics or data visualizer module and create a bar chart showing TB programme case registrations (new enrollments) by month for Western Area Urban district for the year 2022. Save this visualization as a favorite named 'TB Notifications Western Area Urban 2022'. (3) Export the visualization data as a CSV or Excel file and save it to /home/ga/Downloads/. The working list export and the visualization export must both be present in the Downloads folder when complete.
